# ISO 7185 conformance tests — standalone GTest executable.
#
# Each test/Conformance/cases/prtNNNN.cpp contains one TEST() compiled from
# the corresponding ISO 7185 Pascal source.  The files are generated by:
#
#   python3 tools/gen_conformance_tests.py <pastests-dir>
#
# Commit the generated cases/ directory so no external path is required at
# build time.  Re-run the generator only when updating the test suite.

file(GLOB CONFORMANCE_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "cases/prt*.cpp")
list(SORT CONFORMANCE_SOURCES)

if(NOT CONFORMANCE_SOURCES)
    message(STATUS "No conformance test sources found in test/Conformance/cases/; skipping")
    return()
endif()

add_executable(conformance_test ${CONFORMANCE_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(conformance_test PRIVATE ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/test/Support)
target_link_libraries(conformance_test PRIVATE plang_frontend GTest::GTest GTest::Main)
target_precompile_headers(conformance_test PRIVATE
    <gtest/gtest.h>
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/test/Support/TestHelper.h"
)

include(GoogleTest)
gtest_discover_tests(conformance_test)
